in_latin.name: Cornelina
in_latin.meaning: feminine form of Cornelius, horned, cornel tree
in_latin.long_meaning: Cornelina, feminine form of Cornelius, derived from cornu, meaning horn, and the suffix -ina, indicative of a female person. The name Cornelius is associated with the Latin word cornu, meaning horn, and the tree cornel, which was a symbol of strength and protection.
